sec: Preferred regimens, NACO/TLD regimen and post-exposure prophylaxis

items.q: How many drugs are printed in the preferred antiretroviral combination?
TED regimen — match the drug to the dose — 1) Tenofovir 2) Emtricitabine 3) Dolutegravir … A) 200 mg once daily B) 50 mg once daily C) 300 mg once daily
items.exp: 'TED regimen : (300 mg OD) + (200 mg OD) + (50 mg OD)' for tenofovir, emtricitabine and dolutegravir. (Book p1068)

items.q: What does the 'E' in the TED regimen stand for?
NACO / TLD regimen — match the drug to the dose — 1) Tenofovir 2) Lamivudine 3) Dolutegravir … A) 300 mg B) 50 mg once daily C) 300 mg once daily
items.exp: 'NACO regimen / TLD regimen : (300 mg OD) + (300 mg) + (50 mg OD)'. (Book p1068)

items.q: Which backbone drug differs between the TED and the NACO/TLD regimen?
opts: Emtricitabine in TED is replaced by lamivudine in TLD
items.exp: TED uses emtricitabine 200 mg while TLD uses lamivudine 300 mg. (Book p1068)

items.q: Fill up (Post-exposure prophylaxis): 'Optimally effective if started within ______ hours.'
items.exp: 'Prophylaxis (After needle injury) : Optimally effective if started within 72 hours'. (Book p1068)

items.q: What regimen and duration are printed for post-exposure prophylaxis after a needlestick?
Which adverse effect is printed against tenofovir in this section?

Judge the regimen page: I The preferred combination has three drugs, TED being tenofovir, emtricitabine and dolutegravir. II After a needlestick the same TED regimen is given for 4 weeks, ideally started within 72 hours.
items.exp: '3 drug combination : Preferred combination : TED regimen' and 'Prophylaxis (After needle injury) : Optimally effective if started within 72 hours · TED regimen for 4 weeks'. (Book p1068)

items.q: A health-care worker has a needlestick exposure and presents at 60 hours. What does the page advise?
opts: Start the TED regimen for 4 weeks — it is still within the 72-hour window
No prophylaxis is useful after 48 hours
Wait for the source patient's viral load result before starting
items.exp: 'Optimally effective if started within 72 hours · TED regimen for 4 weeks'. (Book p1068)

items.q: Which two integrase-inhibitor-containing regimens are named on the last page of this chapter?
opts: TED and the NACO / TLD regimen
items.exp: Both the TED regimen and the NACO / TLD regimen end with dolutegravir 50 mg once daily. (Book p1068)
